source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the standard deviation (PDF 194-195).

blocks.text: Standard deviation naapti hai ke data mean ke gird kitna bikhra hai. Kam standard deviation ka matlab data mean ke gird ghana hai; zyada ka matlab phaila hai; sifar ke qareeb qeemat ka matlab nuqte mean ke bohat qareeb hain. Hayatiyat mein yeh paudon ki barhne ki raftaar ya enzymes ki miqdar jaise naap ka farq jaanchne ke liye use hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Do ghanti numa curves, mean par dashed lakeerein. (a) Chaura, neecha narangi curve, lamba teer 1 SD: zyada standard deviation. (b) Patla, uncha neela curve, chhota teer 1 SD: kam standard deviation.
blocks.caption: Zyada aur kam standard deviation (kitab ke curves ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Standard deviation naapti hai ke data mean ke gird kitna bikhra hai. Jab qeematein phaili hon to curve chaura aur neecha aur standard deviation zyada hoti hai; jab qeematein mean ke gird ghani hon to curve patla aur uncha aur standard deviation kam hoti hai. Sifar ke qareeb standard deviation ka matlab hai data ke nuqte mean ke bohat qareeb hain.

blocks.text: Formula: standard deviation (sigma) = [(xi - mu) ke murabbon ka jama / N] ka jazr, jahan xi har data nuqta, mu mean aur N data nuqton ki tadaad hai. Qadam: mean nikalein; har qeemat se use tafreeq karein; har inhiraaf ka murabba lein; murabbon ki ausat lein (yeh variance hai); jazr lein.

blocks.caption: Nau paudon ki unchai ki standard deviation (kitab ki misaal)

blocks.text: Variance = 784 / 9 = 87.11, aur standard deviation = 87.11 ka jazr = 9.33 cm.

blocks.prompt: Paudon ke do set ki ausat unchai aik hai. Set X ki SD 2 cm aur set Y ki 9 cm hai. Kaun sa set zyada yaksan hai?
blocks.explanation: Set X: kam standard deviation ka matlab us ki unchaiyan mean ke zyada qareeb hain.

items: SD = mean se inhiraaf ke murabbon ki ausat ka jazr.
Paudon ki misaal: mean 75 cm, variance 87.11, SD 9.33 cm.
Kam SD: ghana data; zyada SD: phaila data.
